x_1577958_dsb_pattern.name: Now Assist, Virtual Agent and AI-assisted service delivery
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.overview: Readiness, then a few skills done well, then scale. (1) Baseline: contact drivers, handle time, knowledge health and ticket text quality (evidence ai.*). (2) Confirm entitlement in writing (Pro Plus / Enterprise Plus and Now Assist assist packs) — installed is not licensed. (3) Governance: an AI use-case register, guardrails (sensitive data masking, human review, role scoping), and a named owner per skill; use AI Control Tower where available. (4) Enable OOB Now Assist skills for the agent persona first — summarisation, resolution notes, knowledge generation — because humans review every output. (5) Fix knowledge before exposing AI Search Q&A and Virtual Agent to users; build VA topics for the top drivers using OOB topic blocks and flows. (6) Consider Predictive Intelligence routing only where ai.pi and ai.ticketdata show enough clean history. (7) Measure acceptance, deflection and assist consumption monthly; add AI agents only after the first wave is proven. No custom LLM integrations while an OOB skill fits.
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.pain: Leadership expects AI value but no use case is sized or measured Knowledge base is small, duplicated or out of date, so AI answers are weak Ticket descriptions and resolution notes are poor quality — models learn little Licensing (Pro Plus / Now Assist packs, assist consumption) is unclear Risk, privacy and security teams have not agreed AI guardrails
x_1577958_dsb_pattern.summary: The client has a working ServiceNow investment and wants practical AI value: fewer contacts, faster agent handling and better routing. Typical blockers are thin or stale knowledge, poor ticket data (empty descriptions, missing categories), unclear licensing and no AI governance. The pattern converges on a data-readiness baseline, a small set of OOB Now Assist skills (case/incident summarisation, resolution notes, knowledge generation, AI Search Q&A) and Virtual Agent topics for the top contact drivers, with guardrails, human review and measured outcomes before scaling to AI agents.
